request.purpose: We benchmark the quality of chronic disease care between hospitals to improve treatment for all patients.
request.question: How many patients with type 2 diabetes have an eGFR below 45, by region?
definitions: Type 2 diabetes = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E11.
Use the latest eGFR (LOINC 62238-1) per patient.
Reduced kidney function = latest eGFR below 45.
Report per region: patients with type 2 diabetes and reduced kidney function.
